**brief:** the hooks log what the agent read after the brief (`.pixel/brief-feedback.jsonl`; `scripts/bench/brief-feedback-summary.py` prints the zero-call rate and the injected-versus-read precision and recall). A short follow-up ("now fix the test") is briefed on the files its transcript and `git status` name, and a session is not sent the same source twice (`.pixel/brief-sessions/`, reset on compact or clear). `PIXEL_BRIEF_LOG`, `_CONTEXT` and `_DEDUPE` set to `0` switch each off.
